text:
The dish looks like scrambled eggs topped with green salsa (salsa verde) and diced tomato, served on a white plate. Plate diameter in the image is about 355 px, which I take to be roughly 26 cm, so about 13.6 px per cm.

The egg mound spans roughly 250 px by 200 px, or about 18 cm by 15 cm in the longest directions. In practice it is less than that, around 14 by 11 cm, and fairly shallow. I estimate about 150 g of eggs, plus about 30 g of salsa and about 25 g of tomato, for a total near 200 g.

Scrambled eggs cooked with butter run about 1.6 kcal/g, so 150 g is about 240 kcal. The salsa adds about 20 kcal and the tomato about 5 kcal. That gives roughly 265 kcal, which I round to 270.

{"kcal": 270, "mass_g": 200}
